text: {"rules":[{"id":"OCULAR-PROPHYLAXIS-NEWBORN","version":"2019","title":"Ocular prophylaxis for gonococcal ophthalmia neonatorum in newborns","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends prophylactic ocular topical medication for all newborns to prevent gonococcal ophthalmia neonatorum.","grade":"A","effective_date":"January 2019","action":"Administer prophylactic ocular topical medication to all newborns to prevent gonococcal ophthalmia neonatorum.","denominator":"{\"age\": {\"min\": 0, \"max\": 0, \"at\": \"end\"}, \"quote\": \"all newborns\", \"derived\": {\"min\": \"'newborns' interpreted as infants born during the measurement year (age 0 at Dec 31); no age number stated in text\", \"max\": \"'newborns' interpreted as infants born during the measurement year (age 0 at Dec 31); no age number stated in text\"}}","numerator":"{\"procedure\": {\"concept\": \"ocular_prophylaxis_newborn\", \"window\": [\"{MY}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"]}, \"quote\": \"prophylactic ocular topical medication\", \"note\": \"Intended to be given shortly after birth; window approximates birth during the measurement year.\"}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["New concept 'ocular_prophylaxis_newborn' (administration of prophylactic ocular topical medication to a newborn) was introduced because no vocabulary concept fits; the grammar has no medication-administration type, so it is encoded as a procedure. Needs human mapping.","The denominator age (0 at end of measurement year) is derived from the word 'newborns'; the text gives no numeric age, so the rule is marked derived for human review.","Ocular prophylaxis is normally given in the birth hospital/delivery setting; a primary-care clinic's EHR may not reliably hold this administration record, so numerator data completeness should be verified before deployment.","Timing of administration (e.g., within hours of birth), specific agent (e.g., erythromycin ointment), and dosing are not stated in this section and are not represented.","The asterisk after 'January 2019 *' refers to an unexplained footnote not included in the section text; its meaning is not represented."]}
